title: NEXY autonomous round 4 — DOC-C incident-link enforcement
scope: DOC-C §11.5–§11.6 IncidentLink contract, persistence integrity, and runtime evidence linkage on dedicated autonomous branch
inputs_summary: Authoritative DOC-C incident-link contract plus live Prisma schema, OBS helpers, worker freeze path, recovery path, and CI evidence.
actions: Proved repo had no canonical IncidentLink model/contract and EventLog/AuditLog lacked incidentId despite DOC-C §11.5–§11.6.
Added canonical IncidentLink contract and Prisma model; renamed the unrelated SecurityIncident self-relation label to SecurityIncidentHierarchy.
Added event_log/audit_log incidentId columns and indexes.
Added migration up/down with backfill, orphan rejection, type/primary/request/trace integrity, linked log ownership checks, duplicate rejection, and secondary incident existence checks.
Added OBS helpers for creating IncidentLink and attaching event/audit/secondary evidence.
Wired worker FREEZE audit rows to primary FreezeIncident graph.
Wired freeze recovery EventLog/AuditLog rows to the primary incident and IncidentLink.
Added exact DOC-C static-gate checks, contract tests, and integration tests.
Large connector batches hit tool-call caps twice before ref mutation; branch was verified unchanged and work was safely split into atomic commits.

claims_proofs.claim: Pre-R4 implementation did not satisfy DOC-C §11.5–§11.6 canonical incident-link contract.
claims_proofs.proof: No IncidentLink persistence model/contract; EventLog/AuditLog lacked incidentId; worker/recovery paths emitted logs without graph linkage.

claims_proofs.claim: R4 adds database-level incident graph integrity rather than only application-level metadata.
claims_proofs.proof: Migration 20260921000000_incident_link_contract installs incident_log_ref_check and incident_link_integrity_check triggers and rollback SQL.

claims_proofs.claim: Primary FreezeIncident evidence is linked in live worker/recovery paths.
claims_proofs.proof: Worker sets AuditLog.incidentId and IncidentLink.linkedAuditLogIds; recovery sets both EventLog/AuditLog incidentId and upserts linked evidence.

claims_proofs.claim: R4 candidate is regression-clean at the tested SHA.
claims_proofs.proof: Workflow 35552336462 passed typecheck, contract, full suite, integration, module-boundary gate, DOC-C §20 static gate, and evidence/release attestation; deploy skipped.

successes: DB rejects orphan/mismatched incident graph references.
Worker and recovery evidence are linked to primary incidents.
Current CI proves the complete R4 head.
failures: Two oversized connector orchestration attempts exceeded tool-call limits; both aborted before branch ref mutation and branch integrity was re-verified before retry.
decisions: IncidentLink is represented as a first-class graph table keyed by incident identity.
EventLog/AuditLog keep optional polymorphic incidentId fields; database triggers enforce existence without cross-tier foreign keys.
No production deployment authorization is inferred from validation success.
unresolved: Branch-local checkpoint still marks R4 pending until a later metadata/candidate commit advances it.
DOC-C §15.2 migration apply/rollback build gate remains unproven.
DOC-E E3/E12 deployment evidence remains incomplete.
risks: Migration SQL has not yet been proven by a real PostgreSQL apply→rollback CI job; current R4 validation proves schema/type/tests/static contract, not DOC-E migration execution evidence.
Other release-blocking obligations may remain despite green current CI.
limits: No merge or production deploy authorized.
rollback: Use prisma/migrations/20260921000000_incident_link_contract/migration.down.sql on the dedicated release rollback path; execution proof is deferred to the next migration-gate finding.
next_actions: Audit and implement DOC-C §15.2 migration apply/rollback build-fail gate and DOC-E E3/E12 proof.
Advance branch checkpoint with R4 PASS_LOCKED in the next branch commit.
dependencies: PostgreSQL migration semantics for next proof
